_note: SYNTHETIC demo playbook. Every expected_effect is an ASSUMPTION for discussion with the HM student, not a measured result. Owners are roles, never named people.

interventions.action: Protect two weekends off in the next roster and cap overtime at 6 h/week
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: overtime and weekend-off features return to normal within 2-4 weeks, lowering risk

interventions.action: Add a seasonal or cross-trained cover shift in peak weeks
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: department load ratio falls below 1.0, spreading overtime

interventions.action: Hold a growth conversation and agree a skill or role step with a date
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: pulse holds or improves; a concrete step reduces resignation intent

interventions.action: Review raise timing at the next pay cycle
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: months since raise resets, removing the stalled-progression driver

interventions.action: Short 1:1 check-in to hear what changed
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: the cause is identified early; pulse decline slows

interventions.action: Recognise recent good work publicly at the shift briefing

clustered_leave_burnout.title: Clustered-leave burnout

interventions.action: Schedule a planned leave block outside the festival rush
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: weeks without leave resets; burnout risk falls

interventions.action: Spread festival leave fairly with a rota agreed in advance
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: fewer staff bunch all leave before festivals

clustered_leave_burnout.support_note: WEAKLY SUPPORTED: the synthetic generator's exit hazard has a weeks-without-leave term but no pre-festival (clustered) leave term, so this driver can only show up through weeks without leave.

interventions.action: Decide on renewal and tell the employee at least 4 weeks before the contract ends
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: wanted staff renew; unplanned gaps fall

interventions.action: Offer a next-season return bonus or priority rehire
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: higher return rate of trained seasonal staff

interventions.action: Benchmark pay against the role average and local hotels
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: gaps above 10% are found and budgeted

interventions.action: Close the gap with a raise or allowance (food, housing, travel)
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: pay ratio reaches ~1.0, removing the pay-gap driver

manager_relationship.title: Manager relationship
manager_relationship.unsupported_reason: UNSUPPORTED: the synthetic data has a manager_id but no signal about the relationship (no manager pulse item, 1:1 records or transfer requests), so the model can never flag this driver.

interventions.action: Add one manager question to the weekly pulse to make this measurable
interventions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: enables this driver in a later model version

interventions.action: Offer a skip-level conversation with the general manager
